title: Smokehouse field lab: continuous signal capture for model-switch risk
creator: Ava Patel
description: Create a lightweight 'smokehouse' field lab to continuously capture buyer-facing signals that indicate model-switch risk and vendor substitution pressure. Deliverables: a prioritized watchlist of 30 signals, an instrumentation spec for product telemetry and sales-ops hooks, a reproducible synthetic workload for low-cost latency/cost probing, an interview plan for 10 enterprise buyers, and a scoreboard that converts signals into operational triggers for sales/ops/infra.
acceptance_criteria: Signal catalog with 30 scored signals (origin, collection method, expected false positive rate)
Instrumentation spec submitted as a Confluence doc with event names, sample payloads, retention guidance
Synthetic workload repo with 3 scenarios and a baseline cost/latency report
Field interview notes for at least 10 unique buyer orgs and a short synthesis deck
Operational scoreboard prototype in the console dashboard (mock or wire) with at least 3 trigger thresholds documented

Primary success metric: proportion of signals that are actionable (lead to a play in sales/ops) during the first quarter after launch.
